text: EV fire on parking level 2, 1225 Loop Fwy, Houston. Time of call: 03:30.

out.briefing:
PRIMESIGHT | EV / PARKING GARAGE FIRE | PARKING LEVEL 2
1225 Loop Fwy, Houston, TX
ABOVE FIRE: whole building, ~57 on floor 1 + ~370 on floors 2-11 by daytime headcount; call at 03:30, likely far fewer on site
ON FLOOR 1: Johnson O'Connor Research Foundation (ste 100); Salvato Interests (ste 115); High Tower Cafe & Deli (ste 118); Heights Chiropractic Center (ste 120) +1 more
FLAGGED: possible IT/UPS batteries at Rack Route Technology fl 3; possible kitchen gas at High Tower Cafe fl 1 (from name only)
PARKING: 360 covered + 120 surface spaces; 1 parking elevator (also 4 passenger, 1 freight)
WATER/WIND: 17 hydrants within 300 m, nearest 68 m N, 137 m W | wind from ENE 7.8 mph, gusts 23.7, smoke drifts WSW | 53F
BUILDING: 11 stories, built 1984, steel frame, sprinklers yes (type not known)
ROOF: membrane | OPEN LOT for staging ~78 m S (aerial search, verify)
INSIDE: no scan of garage or floor 1; nearest is floor 7 (same core, layout may differ); exit signs seen from 9 of 11 scan points, not stair locations
NOT KNOWN: stair and standpipe locations, garage levels and layout, clearance height, EV chargers, neighbouring buildings, building contacts
SCAN: https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=PfDGxZeDnkz
